author: Inside Edition
description: A daughter says she did a wellness check on her father after not hearing from him for weeks and got a shocking surprise. Nora Rowland tells Inside Edition when she arrived at her dad's house, the locks had been changed. She says she rang the doorbell camera and the woman who answered told her that her father had died. Rowland says upon entering the house every trace of him was gone and another person had been living there, a caregiver hired to help her dad.
title: Woman Says Father's Caregiver Stole His House After He Moved To Senior Care

author: Inside Edition
description: He was hanging on for dear life! One wrong move could have proven fatal. A man climbing a mountain got stuck on a ledge and had to call 911 to get rescued. Officials in White County, Georgia say they received a call from a man saying he got stuck while free-climbing Mount Yonah. Officials used a drone to locate him on the mountain and once they did, a firefighter repelled down the mountain to save the climber.
title: Daredevil Hiker Stuck On Ledge Calls 911 With One Hand, Holds On With Other

author: Inside Edition
description: It's a vacation nightmare! People who were visiting the Grand Canyon were hit with flash floods, as rain waters came hammering down, washing boulders and buildings into the Colorado River. Inside Edition spoke to people who were staying at the Phantom Ranch when it was evacuated by officials telling them to move to higher ground. The only way to leave the ranch was to cross a footbridge which would be swept away by the floods.
title: These Vacationers Escaped Deadly Floods At A Grand Canyon Resort

author: Inside Edition
description: The attorney for Lindsay Clancy blasted Nancy Grace after the true crime reporter appeared on Sean Hannity's show on Fox News, claiming Clancy knew what she was doing when she killed her three children in 2023. Speaking to reporters outside of court on the third day of jury deliberations, Kevin Reddington called Grace "The Queen of Mean" and said her coverage of the trial was "horrific." He told Inside Edition Grace needed to be called out.
title: Lindsay Clancy's Attorney Blasts Nancy Grace For Commentary On Case

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman was enjoying dinner at a waterfront restaurant when her engagement ring fell off her finger and into the Hudson River. Denise Rivera tells Inside Edition she was playing around with the ring on her finger when it slipped off her hand, bounced onto the table, fell on the floor and rolled into the murky water. "My heart went with it," she told reporter Allison Hall. Lucky for her, a table of diners who were at the restaurant when it happened were student divers who offered to search for her ring.
title: Student Divers Search Hudson River After Distraught Woman Loses Engagement Ring

author: Inside Edition
description: A breakthrough in treating one of the deadliest diseases. Pancreatic cancer reportedly kills 50,000 Americans a year. After a promising clinical trial, the FDA quickly approved Daraxonrasib, which nearly doubled a patient's survival time compared to chemotherapy. Researchers say it gave patients about 13 months, but not without side effects. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: New Treatment For Pancreatic Cancer Lengthens Survival Time For Patients
